name: ProofHub
summary: ProofHub charges a flat monthly fee instead of a per-user price. Essential costs $45 a month billed annually for 40 projects, and Ultimate Control costs $89 for unlimited projects, before a stated rise to $135. Both plans allow unlimited users.

facts.text: Both plans allow unlimited users with no per-user fee: Essential includes 40 projects and 15GB, and Ultimate Control includes unlimited projects and 100GB.
The pricing FAQ says Ultimate Control is $89 a month on annual billing or $99 on monthly billing for the first three months, then rises to $135 or $150.
The home page describes task lists, board columns, Gantt charts with dependencies, and discussions and comments.
The pricing page does not mention single sign-on.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Billed annually. $50 on monthly billing. 40 projects, unlimited users

plans.name: Ultimate Control
plans.notes: Billed annually. $99 on monthly billing. Rises to $135 and $150 after three months per the FAQ

hiddenCosts: The Ultimate Control price rises after three months, from $89 to $135 a month on annual billing.
The vendor can end the promotional price without notice.
